name: @happy-dom/integration-test
author: David Ortner
description: Private package used for integration testing of Happy DOM.

scripts.test: bun prepare-test.mjs && bun test test --path-ignore-patterns '**/browser-exception-observer/**' && bun test/browser-exception-observer/BrowserExceptionObserver.test.js
scripts.test:ci: bun prepare-test.mjs && bun test test --path-ignore-patterns '**/browser-exception-observer/**' --path-ignore-patterns '**/Browser.test.js' && bun test/browser-exception-observer/BrowserExceptionObserver.test.js
